authorization_revision: 2026-11-05: user instructed use Exp18 CNN and complete/background-launch experiment after incompatible cache was reported; use Exp18 random initialization explicitly
initialization: Exp18 CPU torch.manual_seed(seed) initialization; persist five per-seed states under exp18b/initializations; identical within each seed across all methods/lrs; no pretrained cache weights
dataset: Existing MNIST in repository data/, no downloads or rewrites
privacy: GDP whole fixed-epoch matrix mechanism, add/remove zero-out adjacency, no sampling amplification, three participations spaced by 54 steps

B2LT.source: three audited Exp18 matrices, copied without optimization

algorithm_version: Exact Exp18 optimizer.Update and noise.OnlineNoise; STP-Ex2 PDF adaptive-alpha third column, d0=1, 24 bisections and 1e-6 backoff; source SHA256 frozen
pairing: Same per-seed initialization, fixed permutation repeated each epoch, CUDA innovation generator seed=seed+1000000; no additional trial seeds
validation: All 90 trials evaluate 6000 validation records at steps 54,108,162; never evaluate official test during training
selection: For each optimizer choose common IID/B2LT LR by final validation accuracy averaged equally over both noises and five seeds; ties: lower averaged validation loss, then lower LR; no early stopping
official_test: Freeze best_hyperparameters.json after all 90 complete; evaluate 30 selected checkpoints once each on all 10000 official test records, no retraining
smoke: Six paired-method workers, first formal seed, middle LR, 56 steps each to exercise P=54 boundary, batch 1000 FP32; not full grid trials
statistics: Five-seed mean, sample SD (ddof=1), Student-t 95% CI; B2LT minus IID paired differences, no multiple-comparison adjustment
release_scope: Per-training epsilon=3 does not make the 90-run composition epsilon=3; validation treated as public; raw training losses/clipping diagnostics are internal non-DP audit artifacts
resume: Reuse complete hash-verified trials and test evaluations; preserve incomplete trials for inspection, archive only after all workers exit, restart whole trial with unchanged config/seed
